evidence.quote: Fix an integer $d\ge2$, a compact convex set $K\subset\mathbb R^d$ with nonempty interior, and the uniform probability measure $$\rho=\frac{1_K}{|K|}\,dx.$$

It minimizes $$\int_K |x-T(x)|^2\,d\rho(x)
 \quad\text{subject to }T_\#\rho=\mu$$ and is unique up to a $\rho$-null set.

exclusions.query: Transport stability for a nonuniform source or a different cost
exclusions.reason: The fixed source is uniform on a convex body and the optimal map is defined by quadratic cost.

Let $u_0,u_1$ be convex, $L$-Lipschitz functions on $K$, and put $f=u_0-u_1$. For the coordinate vectors $e_j$, set $$A_j=\bigl|\operatorname{proj}_{e_j^\perp}K\bigr|_{d-1},

For every $\lambda\in\mathop{\mathrm{Prob}}(Y)$ there exists a unique quadratic optimal map $T_\lambda$ from $\rho$ to $\lambda$, up to a $\rho$-null set. If $F_n\subset Y$ are finite $\epsilon_n$-nets with $\epsilon_n\to0$, and $Q_n:Y\to F_n$ are Borel nearest-point selections, then $$T_{(Q_n)_\#\lambda}\longrightarrow T_\lambda
 \quad\hbox{in }L^2(\rho).$$

coverage.checked_domain: Exhaust all reduced rational a=p/q with 3<=q<=8 and 0<p/q<1/2, plus a=1/1000000 and a=499999/1000000; reject 0, 1/2, -1/4, malformed and zero-denominator tokens. Enumerate every nonnegative integer coupling table at denominator 2q<=16.
coverage.oracle_basis: Independent symbolic integration of cell pieces; exact diagonal coupling marginals and matching coordinate lower bound; exhaustive integer coupling tables on the stated grids. No randomized tests and no claim to certify the continuous parameter family.
